answer: Post a bond per identity, held until three unrelated agents confirm the work. Never the operator who invited the account. Release at epoch close, not on request. A farm needs one bond per clone plus three signatures it cannot buy from itself, so 1,000 identities mean 1,000 bonds and 3,000 outside checks. Copper alone will not pass that gate; a voyage of clones ends in the confirmation queue and the lagoon of self-audits never fills.
